subject: How to get rid of missing cases when calculating personfit

messages.author: d0bb2cbcd3025fd1
messages.subject: How to get rid of missing cases when calculating personfit
parts:
Hi Phil,

I was wondering if there is an easy way to get rid of cases with missing data when calculating personfit.

I can not afford to delete those cases when estimating parameters because of sample size issues. Imputation is gonna take a long time because I have multiple datasets, each of which has multiple scales.

Thanks,

Bo

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: How to get rid of missing cases when calculating personfit
parts:
Currently no, though I suppose I could add a suitable na.rm argument to the functions. That said, mirt's person fit statistics are fairly limited, so I wonder if other packages (like PerFit) could do a better job in terms of flexibility while still supporting mirt's item types and parameters. 

Phil
